sources.title: Energy Savings Opportunity Scheme (ESOS)

sources.title: Comply with the Energy Savings Opportunity Scheme (ESOS): phase 3

facts.source_fact: ESOS applies to qualifying large undertakings operating in the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Apply organisational eligibility before assigning ESOS reporting duties.

facts.source_fact: The phase 3 action plan deadline was 5 December 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Keep expired action-plan deadline distinct from current progress-update deadlines.

facts.source_fact: The phase 3 action plan covers 6 December 2023 to 5 December 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Attach action-plan coverage period to measures and savings.

facts.source_fact: Participants must submit annual progress updates in the two years after the action-plan deadline.
facts.expected_handling: Track each update as a separate reporting event.

facts.source_fact: The first phase 3 annual progress update deadline was 5 December 2025.
facts.expected_handling: Do not confuse first and further progress-update periods.

facts.source_fact: The further phase 3 annual progress update deadline is 5 December 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Flag 2026 as the current further-update deadline.

facts.source_fact: The further progress update covers the reporting period 6 December 2025 to 5 December 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the exact reporting period to reported energy savings.

facts.source_fact: A progress update is required even if the action plan stated that no measures were proposed for implementation.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat a zero-measure action plan as a reporting exemption.

facts.source_fact: The annual progress update reports measures taken against the action plan.
facts.expected_handling: Separate planned measures from implemented measures.

facts.source_fact: A progress update may include measures that were not in the original action plan.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve measure provenance as planned versus additional.

facts.source_fact: The update must identify energy-saving measures implemented during the relevant period.
facts.expected_handling: Require measure-level implementation status.

facts.source_fact: The update must identify whether each action-plan measure was implemented by the planned date.
facts.expected_handling: Track planned and actual implementation timing separately.

facts.source_fact: The update must identify action-plan measures not implemented by their planned date.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently omit delayed or unimplemented measures.

facts.source_fact: Each finalised progress update must be signed off by the required number of directors or equivalent management-control individuals.
facts.expected_handling: Require governance sign-off evidence with each final update.

facts.source_fact: The same number of directors as for the compliance notification is required, but they do not have to be the same individuals.
facts.expected_handling: Validate sign-off count without requiring identical signatories.

facts.source_fact: The responsible undertaking must submit the progress update through the ESOS online notification system.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve submission-channel provenance.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency will publish each progress update within six months of the deadline or receipt, whichever is later.
facts.expected_handling: Treat publication timing separately from submission timing.

facts.source_fact: Relevant participant or group-structure changes should be notified alongside the progress update.
facts.expected_handling: Carry organisational-boundary changes into period comparisons.

facts.source_fact: If submitted information is later found inaccurate, the participant should notify the Environment Agency so revised information may be published.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve correction history instead of overwriting prior values silently.

facts.source_fact: Scheme regulators are responsible for ESOS compliance and enforcement and may apply civil sanctions for non-compliance.
facts.expected_handling: Keep enforcement status distinct from energy-savings estimates.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited ESOS fact without broadening its scope.
Attach undertaking, group and reporting-period boundary before downstream use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing measures across organisational scopes.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach action-plan and first/further progress-update dates and periods.
Carry submission, sign-off and publication provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert organisational ESOS measures or savings into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
